purpose: Explicit, report-based scoped seam acceptance for legacy native-assembly and isolated multi-edge-assembly. Algorithmic pixel checks are never visual acceptance.
executionStatus: Code and synthetic tests complete. No real candidate acceptance executed by this implementation task.

candidateContract.generation: Adjacent .generation.json SHA must match explicit finalsha
candidateContract.assembly: Exactly one native-assembly.json or multi-edge-assembly.json; original record is never modified
candidateContract.neighborSource: Actual 4096x4096 files from plan.json, each requiring its corresponding CandidateSha256 frozen hash
candidateContract.unprovidedNeighbors: Unverified; missing interior neighbors and intentional outer-world boundaries are explicitly distinguished

requiredQA.source: engine.qa_images reconstructs every required pixel in memory from current candidate and actual frozen neighbor files
requiredQA.contents: 21 internal seam/return/junction sheets + all 4 boundary sheets + 2 incoming finite registration return sheets + true four-tile corner when all three sources exist
requiredQA.legacyReturnAlias: internal-*-return-plus256-full maps to internal-*-return-256-full; production source pixels remain unchanged
requiredQA.prepareCornerEffect: Creates only absent true four-tile corner PNG and pending generation record. Refuses existing files or missing true sources. actuallyViewed=false; no acceptance.
requiredQA.missingQABehavior: Reject. No view or pass is fabricated by the validator. Missing legacy supplemental boundary images must be created as exact native crops and actually viewed before reports are passed.

item.file: absolute QA PNG inside tile directory
item.sha256: exact PNG SHA from actual review

reportContract.absentNeighborBoundaryVerdict: current_pixels_inspected_neighbor_unverified is allowed only on generated noNeighbor boundary requirements, never internal/shared seams
reportContract.oldCandidateReports: Rejected. Unchanged image reuse must be explicitly documented by the reviewer with its original candidate SHA and reason; the current report must identify the current candidate. Exact current PNG hash and reproduced current pixels remain mandatory. Changing report metadata alone is not evidence of another view.
reportContract.coverage: Every required image must occur in passed reports; every reported extra image is checked too
reportContract.freezeChecks: Candidate, neighbor files, plan, source assembly, candidate generation metadata, QA PNGs and source reports are rechecked before metadata writes

extraQA.recipeSources: current or actual supplied neighbor role
extraQA.recipeRules: Integer native crops within actual 4096 sources, optional ROTATE_90 for inspection only, complete exactly-once coverage, no resampling, no uncovered or overlapping pieces

approvalWrites: hash-addressed text snapshots of existing pending metadata
approvalGuards: Any already scopedLocalSeamsPassed=true destination blocks every write. Original assembly, candidate PNG and source PNGs are never changed. Candidate generation history is retained by reference.
testScope: 40 installed-source tests: 31 existing acceptance gates unchanged plus 9 current-source/lifecycle regressions.

sourceMetadataContract.retention: Only actual removed entries from an existing same-tile ledger are mapped to path+SHA references, with absent-image verification; all acquisition TEXT remains immutable.
sourceMetadataContract.newRepairs: Never inferred retired merely because older native sources were removed.
